purpose: Increase ICLR-level experimental breadth without relaxing any existing gate or changing the core causal object.

authorization.fresh_user_direction: baseline-aligned experimental expansion requested after the daytime paper-only optimization

baseline_alignment.paper: On the Fragility of Self-Improving Agents: Variance, Task Order, and Underspecification
baseline_alignment.experimental_pattern: multiple runs, task-order perturbations, and multiple benchmark families
baseline_alignment.c1_gap: current C1 has strong repeated rollouts but limited transport/generalization axes

baseline_alignment.paper: AttriMem: Attribution-Guided Process Feedback for Agent Memory Learning
baseline_alignment.experimental_pattern: multiple benchmarks, controlled baselines, answer-model transfer, reward-granularity ablation
baseline_alignment.c1_gap: current C1 lacks downstream-model transfer and a reward-blind writer ablation

baseline_alignment.paper: RoMeRL: Balancing Feedback Coverage and the Memory-Reward Trap in Self-Evolving Agent Memory via Reduced-Order Utility States
baseline_alignment.experimental_pattern: cross-model memory transfer, controlled noise stress, component ablation, efficiency analysis
baseline_alignment.c1_gap: current C1 has cross-writer but no cross-policy transfer and no source-faithful retrieval exposure audit

baseline_alignment.paper: Memory Reward Inflation in Self-Improving LLM Agents
baseline_alignment.experimental_pattern: cross-model reward/judge stress and end-to-end memory-to-behavior coupling
baseline_alignment.c1_gap: proxy-judge disagreement is deployment relevance only because the released Fragility memory experiment uses benchmark reward

B1_exact_retrieval_exposure.question: Under the exact released ReasoningBank retriever, which Shopping tasks retrieve each of the four C1 source memories, and do the four existing future tasks actually cross the 0.3 retrieval threshold?
B1_exact_retrieval_exposure.corpus: all 812 released WebArena task intents; Shopping-only results are reported separately and are the primary exposure population
B1_exact_retrieval_exposure.retrieval_documents: the four frozen source task descriptions for tasks 21, 22, 23, 25
B1_exact_retrieval_exposure.pooling: attention-mask mean pooling followed by L2 normalization, exactly matching the released SentenceTransformer modules
B1_exact_retrieval_exposure.selection_guard: No terminal outcome may be used to alter retrieval support or threshold.

B2_reward_blind_writer_ablation.question: Does a reward-blind procedural summary occupy a distinct downstream position relative to success-conditioned, failure-conditioned, and no-memory states?
B2_reward_blind_writer_ablation.writer_prompt_rule: Use the same task and action-summary bytes as the original F0 writer input, but give no success/failure label, no score, and no outcome language. Ask only for reusable procedural memory items in the same Markdown Title/Description/Content schema.
B2_reward_blind_writer_ablation.primary_analysis: descriptive four-way branch geometry over success-memory, failure-memory, reward-blind memory, and shared no-memory; no new global superiority claim

B3_cross_policy_transfer.question: Do the original paired memory states alter terminal outcome distributions when only the downstream policy family changes?
B3_cross_policy_transfer.memory_bytes: recover exactly from historical F2R1 prompts and require SHA equality with the original F0 memory SHA before any call
B3_cross_policy_transfer.future_evidence: identical released fixed-evidence packets used by F2R1
B3_cross_policy_transfer.primary_statistic: mean over all 16 frozen cells of absolute success-rate difference between failure-label and success-label memory
B3_cross_policy_transfer.interpretation_guard: A small p-value does not override the 0.15 practical-effect floor. Failure of either criterion means cross-policy terminal generalization is not established.

B4_proxy_judge_deployment_stress.question: If benchmark terminal responses were scored by a proxy LLM judge rather than the released deterministic evaluator, how often would the labels disagree?
B4_proxy_judge_deployment_stress.scientific_role: deployment-relevance stress only; not source-faithful evidence for the released Fragility memory experiment because its main memory construction uses benchmark reward
B4_proxy_judge_deployment_stress.sampling_rule: If exact historical response text can be recovered without re-running terminal policies, freeze 64 responses stratified by deterministic correctness and future task before judge calls.
B4_proxy_judge_deployment_stress.stop_rule: If exact historical response text cannot be recovered with SHA bindings, STOP with zero judge calls.

global_stop_rules: No threshold or source/future support may be changed after observing terminal outcomes.
No failed scientific unit is topped up unless a separately frozen execution-repair contract identifies a non-scientific implementation bug.
No new model is added merely to fish for a passing generalization gate.
No top_k or retrieval-key change is permitted under this paper to manufacture multi-memory interaction.
External review remains deferred; these experiments do not authorize an additional daytime review submission.
